name: EncryptTextWithAes
label: Encrypt Text with AES
description: Encrypts a string using AES encryption. Short keys are hashed securely to 32 bytes.

fields.name: Plaintext
fields.label: Plaintext to Encrypt
fields.description: The text you want to encrypt.

fields.name: Key
fields.label: Encryption Key
fields.description: Secret key used for encryption. Short keys will be hashed to 32 bytes (AES-256).

fields.name: EncodingFormat
fields.label: Encoding Format
fields.description: Encoding used for the encrypted output: Base64 or Hex.

fields.name: EncryptedText
fields.label: Encrypted Text Result
fields.description: Returns the encrypted text based on selected encoding format.
